name: Langenberg (Westfalen, Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and blue in the proportions 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Langenberg (a blue pale between blue snowflake-like figures on white).
history: The arms were approved by deed of the Regierungspräsident in Detmold of 15 December 1976; the flag was approved on 15 December 1977.

features.role: Langenberg arms — pale and figures on white
